text: FAA guidance emphasizes initiating emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link and applying risk management when the link is compromised. The Autel EVO Max 4N manual describes reconnection attempts during signal loss, automatic return-to-home if the link is restored within 10 seconds, and a user-set signal-loss action if the link remains broken beyond 10 seconds. The Autel incident reports are unverified accounts stating loss of control, drifting away despite input, failures of Return To Home, and unlocated platforms. Main gap: there is a lack of corroborated evidence linking official procedures to observed outcomes, leaving notable conflict between documented guidance and reported incidents. Also, no usable evidence found in the approved Autel incident report collection.
